summary: Added a `--print` mode to `internal/tools/setversion` (reads the plugin manifest's version via the existing regexp, writes nothing) with new tests, and wired `Taskfile.yml`'s `build` task to shell that out into an `-ldflags` var so `task build -o takt ./cmd/takt` stamps the binary while a plain `go build ./...` stays as the compile check for the rest of the tree.
